LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploStart: Select actions, set their terms, then Send deal.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploReduced: Other factions support war, peace and silver only.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploReviewHelp: Everything listed below is included. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploAgreementHelp: These deals are already signed. View their obligations or end them here.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploWarImmediate: War starts immediately. No agreement needed.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploBlockedWar: Remove Declare war to add other terms.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploBlockedPeace: Make peace with this House first.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploBlockedService: A soldier loan is already active with this House.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploBlockedTrade: A trade pact is already active with this House.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploBlockedJobs: Both a supply job and an attack job are already active.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploBlockedPeople: A marriage or ward agreement is already active with this House.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploBlockedMigration: A smallfolk agreement is already active with this House.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploBlockedTrial: A trial is already active. Complete or cancel it first.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploBlockedBond: A feudal bond already exists with this House.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploCheckFealty: A feudal bond requires peace and an eligible Westerosi House.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploNoTraders: This House has no caravan traders.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploHostile: Resolve hostile relations with this House first.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploIntrigueAttention: Active intrigue: view your agent or the threat
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploCheckPrisoners: No eligible captive exchange is currently available.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploCheckMigration: Smallfolk agreements are unavailable. Check the four-agreement limit and House relations.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploCheckTrial: Trials are unavailable. Check House relations and the trial limit.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploCheckOther: Current requirements are not met. Check signed agreements and House details.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_DeclareWar: This House becomes your enemy immediately.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_OfferPeace: End the war if they accept your terms.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_DemandPeace: Ask to end the war on your terms. They can refuse.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_SwearOath: They become your liege. You owe taxes, supplies and military service.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_DemandOath: They become your vassal and owe you taxes, supplies and service.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_OfferSilver: Give them silver now, or promise a daily payment.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_DemandSilver: Ask them to pay you now, or make daily payments.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_OfferLevies: Send soldiers from your holdings to serve them temporarily.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_DemandLevies: Their soldiers strengthen your holdings for the agreed time.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_OfferLand: Permanently give them one of your eligible holdings.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_DemandLand: Ask them to permanently give you an eligible holding.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_TradePact: Their trade caravans visit on the schedule you choose.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_AskForJob: Earn silver by delivering supplies or attacking a shared enemy.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_Prisoners: Agree a caravan handover of named captives and optional ransom.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_RequestSettlers: Request a transfer of smallfolk from their lands to yours.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_OfferSettlers: Offer a transfer of smallfolk from your lands to theirs.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_Trial: Choose two champions and arrange a trial at a marked site.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_Marriage: Arrange a willing adult marriage or a political-only marriage contract.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_Foster: Host their child, or send yours, for a temporary ward stay.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploResult_Squire: Host or send a young person for temporary squire service.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_DeclareWar: Unjustified war and broken promises reduce Integrity. Battles can kill.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_OfferPeace: Any silver, land or soldier terms you add are part of the same deal.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_DemandPeace: Uses the same acceptance rules as Offer peace; demands do not force agreement.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_SwearOath: You can serve one liege. Leaving or breaking the bond has penalties.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_DemandOath: Submission requires acceptance; strength and war exhaustion matter.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_OfferSilver: Immediate silver is paid on acceptance. Daily payments continue; missed dues have penalties.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_DemandSilver: Their treasury limits payment. Asking for more lowers acceptance.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_OfferLevies: Your holdings lose these soldiers and their workforce until survivors return.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_DemandLevies: Requires room in your garrisons. These soldiers leave when the term ends.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_OfferLand: The transfer is permanent. You lose its taxes, people and garrison.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_DemandLand: The transfer is permanent and difficult to negotiate.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_TradePact: More frequent visits are harder to negotiate. War ends the pact.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_AskForJob: You must do the job. Missing deadlines or abandoning it costs Integrity.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_Prisoners: Signing only reserves the exchange. Travel and handover must be completed within 20 days.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_RequestSettlers: Complete the signed journey; signing alone does not deliver the smallfolk.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_OfferSettlers: The transfer removes smallfolk from your lands. Complete the signed journey.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_Trial: Champions can be wounded or killed. Cancellation costs 8 Integrity.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_Marriage: Signing moves nobody. Consent and dispatch are confirmed separately; a completed marriage transfers the travelling spouse.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_Foster: Provide food, beds and care. Neglect, captivity or death brings penalties.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploRisk_Squire: This is a temporary protected guest, not a recruit or draftable soldier.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploIntrigueWarning: Intrigue is separate from your deal. Launching spends silver immediately; discovery can cost Integrity and goodwill.
LanguageData.ARIO_SimpleDiploUnavailable: [A Rim of Ice and Fire] Simple diplomacy UI unavailable; original panel retained: {0}
